result.instructions: Tools for Loop, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which subscriptions failed their last payment this week?"; "Show me the upcoming orders for the next 14 days."; "Pause the subscription of customer 6123 for one month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Loop data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run loopsubscriptions_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run loopsubscriptions_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run loopsubscriptions_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. loopsubscriptions_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: Read one subscription: status, billing, delivery, products and next order. Loop API: GET /subscription/{subscriptionId}.

subscription_id.description: Subscription id: the Loop id (12345), 'loop-12345', or 'shopify-<shopifySubscriptionId>'.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_subscriptions
tools.title: List subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions for the store, with optional filters and cursor paging. This list has a small per-store pool (3 requests per 3 s); use filters. Loop API: GET /subscription.

updated_after.description: Only subscriptions updated from this time (Unix epoch, integer).

updated_before.description: Only subscriptions updated up to this time (Unix epoch, integer).

next_billing_after.description: Next billing from this time (Unix epoch, integer).

next_billing_before.description: Next billing up to this time (Unix epoch, integer).

created_after.description: Created from this time (Unix epoch, integer).

created_before.description: Created up to this time (Unix epoch, integer).

after_cursor.description: Cursor: pass pageInfo.nextCursor from the previous response.

page_size.description: Records per page (Loop default when omitted).

tools.description: List the subscriptions of the customer with this email address. Use it when the Shopify customer id is unknown. Loop API: GET /customer/{customerEmailAddress}/subscription.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_list_selling_plan_groups
tools.title: List selling plan groups
tools.description: List the subscription selling plan groups of the store (the billing and delivery plans offered). Loop API: GET /sellingPlanGroup.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_pause_subscription
tools.title: Pause subscription
tools.description: Pause a subscription: no billing and no deliveries until it resumes. Pass pause_duration to pause for a fixed time; omit it to pause until resumed. Loop API: POST /subscription/{subscriptionId}/pause.

subscription_id.description: Subscription id: the Loop id (12345), 'loop-12345', or 'shopify-<shopifySubscriptionId>'.

pause_duration.description: Optional fixed pause. Field names are the Loop API's camelCase.

intervalCount.description: Length of the pause, in intervalType units.

resumeDateEpoch.description: Resume date, as the Loop docs define it.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_resume_subscription
tools.title: Resume subscription
tools.description: Resume a paused subscription on its original schedule. This restarts billing and deliveries. Loop API: POST /subscription/{subscriptionId}/resume.

subscription_id.description: Subscription id: the Loop id (12345), 'loop-12345', or 'shopify-<shopifySubscriptionId>'.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_skip_next_order
tools.title: Skip next order
tools.description: Skip the next scheduled order of a subscription; later orders stay scheduled. This changes what the customer is charged and shipped. Loop API: POST /subscription/{subscriptionId}/skipNext.

subscription_id.description: Subscription id: the Loop id (12345), 'loop-12345', or 'shopify-<shopifySubscriptionId>'.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_reactivate_subscription
tools.title: Reactivate subscription
tools.description: Reactivate a cancelled subscription on its original schedule. This restarts billing. Loop API: POST /subscription/{subscriptionId}/reactivate.

subscription_id.description: Subscription id: the Loop id (12345), 'loop-12345', or 'shopify-<shopifySubscriptionId>'.

tools.name: loopsubscriptions_update_note
tools.title: Update subscription note
tools.description: Replace the internal note on a subscription. The customer does not see it. Loop API: PUT /subscription/{subscriptionId}/note.

subscription_id.description: Subscription id: the Loop id (12345), 'loop-12345', or 'shopify-<shopifySubscriptionId>'.

note.description: The new note text (replaces the old note).
